gmdn.gmdnPTName: Nuclear medicine clinical assessment support software
gmdn.gmdnPTDefinition: A software program intended to display, analyse/process, and possibly acquire nuclear medicine images, to support a healthcare provider with clinical assessment (e.g., diagnosis, triage, image quality enhancement) of a condition. The images are acquired via a gamma camera, positron emission tomography (PET) or single photon emission computed tomography (SPECT); it may in addition be designed for use in conjunction with x-ray or magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) devices. It is not dedicated to treatment planning and does not incorporate adaptive/dynamic machine learning (ML) models.
